parsed.rationale: Three distinct types — `HSBColor` (package `ColorPalette`), `AccentColor`, and `HSBOffset` (both in package `Wallpaper`, file `ThemeColors.swift`) — each independently declare an identical `init(hue:saturation:brightness:)` initializer. Because these are value types in separate packages that cannot share a common base class, the idiomatic Swift solution is to introduce a protocol `HSBInitializable` with a required `init(hue:saturation:brightness:)` requirement, placed in the `ColorPalette` package (which `Wallpaper` already depends on, given it uses HSB concepts). Each conforming type retains its own stored properties but satisfies the protocol requirement, eliminating the triplicated initializer shape and enabling generic code that constructs any HSB-initializable color.
